notes: Orion 3.6 — one fix: the microphone. Wake listening is now silent, like Hey Google. Before, the speech recognizer restarted every few seconds in a quiet room and played its start beep on every restart — that is the listening noise you kept hearing. Now the recognizer's system sounds are muted for exactly the window around each listen and restored the moment Orion needs to speak, so Orion's own voice is never turned down. Restarts follow a real policy: quiet-room no-matches and timeouts are the normal rhythm and relisten silently; a recognizer in a bad state gets destroyed, recreated, and backed off exponentially instead of tight-looping; a missing permission stops the loop instead of buzzing forever. New Terms section 6W states the silent-wake rules — the app will ask you to agree again, once. What only your phone can prove: the actual silence — leave wake listening on in a quiet room and you should hear nothing at all until Orion speaks.
